pagedata.pyDescription: COMMIT ALL DATABASE CHANGES IN THE THREAD. UNLIKE THE COMMIT METHOD THIS ROUTINE ONLY COMMITS CHANGES IF THERE ARE NO PAGE ERRORS ON THE PRIMARY PAGE (WORKPAGE) OR IF THIS IS BEING CALLED FROM A SCREENFLOW AND THE COMMIT IS DEFERRED. IF COMMIT FAILS, IT WILL ROLLBACK AND UNLOCK.
pagedata.pyLabelOld: BPM engine API: commit, if errors rollback and unlock REST
pagedata.pyUsage: The caller must call this with a primary page that inherits from Work-. GUI or service wrapper activities should call this activity to commit, as opposed to calling commit directly. Errors are added to a property pyCommitError instead of added as page messages since sometimes page-level messages are stripped off.

rowdata.pyStepsDescription: now commit unless there are errors

rowdata.pxWarningMessage: Writing application logic using the Java activity method impacts maintainability, discourages reusability, and increases risk during upgrades. Use this method only when necessary. If executing Java code is required, consider using the Call-Function activity method to execute a Function rule. Using Function rules encourages creating well-defined input and output parameters and can be reused across many different types of rules.

Use of the Commit activity method interferes with the PRPC transaction model and may result in stale database records. Consider removing; In most cases, PRPC already does a commit at the end of the transaction.

Use of an internal activity from another ruleset is not recommended. The calling signature of these rules may change over time, or they may be deprecated completely. Consider using non-internal activities instead.
The use of activity rules should be limited. The need for activities can be reduced by using data transforms, as well as techniques such as case management, the Engine API, and declaratives.
Be careful not to write sensitive or confidential information, including encrypted properties and any properties from encrypted BLOBs, to logs.
You should create a test case for this rule to identify any regression issues that might occur when this rule is modified.
